model_scope: Rolex GMT-Master II 126710BLNR (Batman/Batgirl, both bracelet variants; date/cyclops/bezel geometry out of scope)

source_report.measurement_pipeline: tools/research/build_gmt_genuine_baseline.py + tools/research/run_pinned_gmt_baseline.py, reusing the frozen experiment/gmt-proportional-geometry-v1 tools/watch_align_py measurement code unchanged

pose_gate.definition: apparent tilt <= 10 degrees (result.tilt_deg from the minute-track-first pose solve), same gate used throughout experiment/gmt-proportional-geometry-v1's Stage 1-3 calibration work
pose_gate.note: Higher-tilt images were measured but explicitly excluded from this primary baseline; they exist only as stress-test evidence in the underlying research, not folded into these statistics.

population.unit_of_independence: physical_watch_id (repeated photographs of one watch are collapsed to a single per-watch median before any population statistic is computed)
population.warning: 5 independent genuine watches is enough to proceed to blind replica-control validation but is NOT a validated Rolex manufacturing tolerance. Every numeric band below is a literal descriptive statistic of this specific small sample.

not_authenticated_ground_truth: Source pages identify these watches as genuine (dealer/auction-house/CPO listings). This is not independent physical authentication, and this profile is not an authenticity classifier or manufacturing-tolerance specification.

metrics.definition: 12-triangle apex point, affine-normalised canonical radial coordinate (dial-radius units, r=0 at dial centre).
metrics.notes: Tightest useful 12 radial signal in the primary sample; stable when the primary sample expanded from 4 to 5 watches (0.5537 -> 0.5512).

metrics.definition: 12-triangle centroid point, projective-corrected canonical radial coordinate (round-marker-corridor fit per photo).
metrics.notes: One of five primary watches has no usable projective detection (round-marker corridor unavailable), hence n=4 not 5. Stable across sample expansion (0.7398 -> 0.7389).

metrics.definition: 12-triangle base-centre point, projective-corrected canonical radial coordinate (same per-photo corridor fit as centre_radial_projective).
metrics.notes: Same n=4 coverage caveat as centre_radial_projective. Stable across sample expansion (0.8122 -> 0.8141).

metrics.definition: Signed, length-normalised perpendicular distance from the canonical origin (dial centre) to the line through the 12 triangle's apex and base-centre canonical points. Zero means the observed symmetry axis passes exactly through the dial centre.
metrics.notes: Wider photographic/detection variation than the radial or tangential-offset metrics; kept diagnostic until replica separation is demonstrated.

metrics.definition: Signed tangential (perpendicular-to-axis) canonical displacement of the 12 triangle's contour centroid from the nominal 12 axis. Positive = clockwise (right when facing the dial).
metrics.notes: Promising lateral-placement signal; one of the tightest MAD values in the primary sample alongside the 6/9 tangential metrics.

metrics.definition: 6 o'clock baton marker centre, affine-normalised canonical radial coordinate.
metrics.notes: Not named in the validation report's integration decision as PROMISING (only 12 radial and 12/6/9 tangential placement were explicitly promoted); one low-side genuine/detection value broadens the band. Held diagnostic pending its own blind-validation evidence rather than assumed promising by extension.

metrics.definition: 6 o'clock baton marker centre, tangential (lateral) canonical offset from the nominal 6 axis.
metrics.notes: Promising lateral-placement signal, explicitly named in the validation report's integration decision.

metrics.definition: 6 o'clock baton principal-axis orientation residual, degrees.
metrics.notes: Explicitly called out in the validation report as too noisy for a hard QC threshold at present; genuine sample already spans a broad upper tail.

metrics.definition: 6 o'clock baton radial extent (outer_r - inner_r), canonical units.
metrics.notes: Size/segmentation diagnostic; broad lower tail consistent with segmentation sensitivity, not treated as a manufacturing tolerance.

metrics.definition: 9 o'clock baton marker centre, affine-normalised canonical radial coordinate.
metrics.notes: Same reasoning as h06.centre_radial: similar behaviour, not explicitly named PROMISING in the validation report's integration decision.

metrics.definition: 9 o'clock baton marker centre, tangential (lateral) canonical offset from the nominal 9 axis.
metrics.notes: Promising lateral-placement signal, explicitly named in the validation report's integration decision.

metrics.definition: 9 o'clock baton principal-axis orientation residual, degrees.
metrics.notes: More stable than 6-marker rotation but explicitly "not yet independently validated as a defect discriminator" per the validation report -- PROMISING for blind validation only, not production warning.

metrics.definition: 9 o'clock baton radial extent (outer_r - inner_r), canonical units.
metrics.notes: Size/segmentation diagnostic; broad lower tail, same reasoning as h06.radial_span.

explicit_non_definitions.no_defect_thresholds: This profile defines an empirically observed genuine-image distribution only. It does not define, imply, or compute any pass/fail boundary.
explicit_non_definitions.no_authenticity_score: This profile makes no authenticity, GL/RL, factory, or combined-quality determination.
explicit_non_definitions.no_manufacturing_tolerance: p10/p90 and MAD describe this specific small photographic sample, not a Rolex manufacturing specification.
explicit_non_definitions.no_android_production_wiring: Loading this profile does not by itself enable any new production QC finding; see the accompanying validation report for which metrics, if any, are promoted to Final QC.

update_policy: A future genuine sample expansion must be published as profile_version 2 (or later) with its own frozen_date and source_report, never by silently editing these numbers in place. Code that reads this file should treat profile_id + profile_version as the cache/compatibility key.
